surat.headline: Surat cluster faces input-cost and labor strains offset by regulatory reliefs.
what_changed: Yarn price surges of 45% to 66% threatened early Diwali shutdowns for loom and textile units.
Labor agitations and wage protests intensified across Surat's embroidery and textile segments, driving worker detentions and reverse migration.
GST Council provided relief with Input Tax Credit refunds and reduced highway inspections.
stress_signals: Surat loom units faced early 15-day closures due to a Rs 50/kg yarn price hike [b567711c9ed4].
Embroidery sector impasse continued alongside protests, wage disputes, and worker detentions [7697e96a190e, e7921383cbb7].
Diamond exports dropped 7% amidst a polished diamond shipment slump [975918f112f3], with reports of payment defaults on polishing wages [698c779932f2].
Multiple cheating, fraud, and payment default cases filed involving yarn, fabric, and diamond traders [2718cba9f837].
improvement_signals: GST Council granted ITC refunds and eased highway checks for Surat textiles [17f0a015a73c].
Central government is studying the Surat textile hub to formulate a national policy [a3db8ea1103a].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital utilization and early Diwali shutdown risks among weaving and loom units.
Track resolution of embroidery labor disputes and migrant worker retention.
Watch diamond export recovery and wage trend normalization in polishing units.
